subject: gk
question: Vultures are:
solution:
The correct answer is __C**arnivores**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vultures primarily feed on the flesh of dead animals, making them **scavengers** within the carnivore classification. They play a crucial ecological role by consuming carcasses that could otherwise spread diseases to other animals and humans.
 
• Their feeding behavior is specialized towards a carnivorous diet, as they have strong beaks and digestive systems capable of breaking down tough tissues and even handling bacteria that would be harmful to other animals.
 
• This makes them an essential part of the ecosystem, particularly in their role in naturally disposing of dead animals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Scavengers **are animals that consume dead animals and plant material. They feed on carcasses of dead animals. Scavengers do not generally kill their food but instead eat what has already died. Example: Vultures,hyenas, raccoons
 
• An **omnivore** is an organism that regularly consumes a variety of material, including plants, animals, algae, and fungi example **Dog, cat ,human**
 
• **Decomposers : **An organism, often a bacterium, fungus, or invertebrate that feeds on and breaks down dead plant or animal matter, making organic nutrients available to the ecosystem. **example : bacteria and fungi **
 
• An **herbivore** is an organism that feeds mostly on plants.
